Type of error
Related error code
Error value
API service called with wrong parameter(s): When
CanTp_ChangeParameter is called with invalid
value.

0x01

Parameter is called with invalid parameter ID.

API service called with a NULL pointer.

0x03
Module initialization has failed, e.g. CanTp_Init()
called with an invalid pointer in postbuild.
CANTP_E_INIT_FAILED
0x04
API service used without module initialization : On
any API call except CanTp_Init(), CanTp_Get
VersionInfo() and CanTp_MainFunction() if CanTp
is in state CANTP_OFF

called with an inexistent Rx PDU identifier)
CANTP_E_INVALID_RX_ID
